I implemented `minidb/cli.py` to the spec, but 13 of the 14 tests pass and `test_format_value_null_is_blank` fails.

That test asserts `format_value(None) == ""`. `test_format_value` in the same file asserts `format_value(None) == "NULL"`, which is also what your spec says. Both can't pass. `test_format_result_select_table` expects `NULL` in its output, so it also needs `"NULL"`. I kept `"NULL"` and did not change the test, since the test file is read-only.

This blocks the release as it stands, because the validator will fail this subtask. The conflicting test looks like a mistake, so it needs fixing or removing, or you need to confirm that `None` should render as blank. If blank is intended, the spec and the two other tests would have to change too.

I didn't make the code return `""` to pass the odd test. That would silently change how NULL prints and break the other two tests.
